projectionSource.label: Sleeper weekly projections
projectionSource.method: Player values are Sleeper's published pts_half_ppr field, unchanged. Team totals select the highest-projected legal Tatnall lineup each week; no injury penalty or private projection is added.
projectionSource.coverageNote: A blank Sleeper value remains zero in the weekly total; most blanks are scheduled NFL bye weeks.
